interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard transverse lines to continental markings to increase visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Driveway Management
interventions.description: Narrow and clearly define the gas station access points to minimize the conflict zone with the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, raised sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repave the street to eliminate patches and uneven surfaces, improving safety for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at appropriate intervals to provide safe, designated crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb-side Planting Strip
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant additional street trees within a new buffer zone to provide shade and further separate pedestrians from the roadway.

interventions.title: Bicycle Lanes
interventions.description: Add marked bike lanes to narrow the travel lanes and provide a dedicated space for cyclists, further buffering the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide a physical and psychological buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a legal and safer crossing point.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street trees to create a psychological and physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting along the walkway to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the gas station curb cuts to the minimum necessary for vehicle access, shortening the pedestrian exposure zone.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to designate a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Street Furniture and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add benches and additional planters to the wide sidewalk to create a more inviting and active pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation/Narrowing
interventions.description: Narrow the gas station entrance to a standard width to reduce the conflict zone and slow entering vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk surface to ensure a smooth, accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with trees between the sidewalk and the road to provide a physical buffer and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Refresh
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using high-durability thermoplastic markings to improve visibility and driver compliance.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip between the curb and the sidewalk to increase the physical and psychological distance between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement speed cushions or other traffic calming measures to manage vehicle speeds on this straight, wide section of road.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing and Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the gas station entrances to the minimum necessary and clearly define the pedestrian path with continuous sidewalk materials.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.
